recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-22729 unless Patient Care reintroduces an inline CarePlan activity detail backbone or separately chooses to clean up unused historical CarePlan terminology files.
issue_request: FHIR-22729 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking to add an example binding for CarePlan.activity.detail.statusReason to a value set combining Procedure not-performed reason, Immunization status reason, and MedicationRequest status reason value sets.
initial_application: The Jira-linked aeca750524eb7dfa7218b4679e4cedf7be4af7c1 commit updated the CarePlan spreadsheet to bind CarePlan.activity.detail.statusReason to CarePlanActivityStatusReason and added source/careplan/valueset-care-plan-activity-status-reason.xml. The later XML StructureDefinition conversion carried that binding forward as CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.statusReason.
additional_context: CarePlan remains in the active current build. A later Published Patient Care decision, FHIR-39101, removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and all children and uses CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference for planned activities. The current StructureDefinition comments out the old plannedActivityDetail block, and FHIR-39101 plus the neighboring FHIR-22733 audit are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is appropriate because there is no active current CarePlan activity.detail/plannedActivityDetail.statusReason element to bind, and reintroducing or editing the obsolete inline backbone would conflict with the later removal decision.
